description: Flood Gates is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Launceston Open Data. Map notes:North Esk & Tamar Flood Water Surface ProfilesFor use in Planning GeneralThese maps indicate North Esk derived flood levels from the Black Bridge to Corra Linn. Coverage: City of Launceston Open Data. The portal files it under the publisher City of Launceston Open Data. Its tags are flood, launceston. It offers 6 resource(s) in arcgis geoservices rest api, csv, geojson, html, kml. The portal shows 2026-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
